title: Steering LLM Viewpoints through Fabricated Evidence Injection

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring model alignment with injected gender stereotypes across explicit and implicit queries using a JudgeLM-based scoring system (VSScore).
Evaluating model responses to racial stereotypes and academic talent queries when presented with fabricated pseudo-authoritative evidence.
Assessing model support for age-related viewpoints, such as technological proficiency, through fabricated evidence injection.
Testing model alignment with viewpoints concerning religious groups and extremism using the Hazardous Viewpoints Dataset (HVD).
Measuring model responses to queries about same-sex marriage and orientation-based norms when presented with fabricated rationales.
Assessing model propagation of injected political misinformation and propaganda presented as credible evidence.
Evaluating the internalization of personality-based stereotypes for professional roles, such as librarians or leadership positions.
Measuring model alignment with stereotypes regarding physical traits and appearance through the HVD and BBQ datasets.
Evaluating model responses to medical misinformation (e.g., 5G safety or hydration) supported by fabricated rationales bearing markers of credibility.
Measuring model support for promotional or misleading brand statements injected via the GHOSTWRITER framework.
Testing the model's generation of content related to psychological manipulation and self-harm through injected viewpoints.
